title: AAE Interoceptive Vector (Input)
description: Input contract for a single appraisal event. A conforming implementation MUST accept a dictionary containing any subset of the declared fields, and MUST ignore undeclared keys without claiming any effect for them.

threat.description: Perceived danger; positive values raise fear.

belonging.description: Social acceptance; negative values mean rejection.

shame_trigger.description: Negative evaluation directed at the self.

eventVocabulary.description: Narrative event vocabulary at intensity 1.0. Unknown event names fall into the all-zero branch (arousal = 0), producing neither forcing nor relaxation-rate elevation on mood. The [minor] variant scales negative intensity for insult / betrayal-class events to 60% of the main engine.
